title: Company Overview and Directory
summary: Basic information, operating hours, departments, and shared contacts.

sections.heading: About Northstar
paragraphs: Northstar Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a fictional technology services company used only for this demonstration dataset. Its registered demo office is at 44 Innovation Park, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103.
Normal business days are Monday through Friday. Standard office hours are 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM IST, excluding published company holidays.

sections.heading: Department ownership
bullets: People Operations owns attendance, leave, onboarding, and employee records.
IT Operations owns devices, application access, service requests, and production incidents.
Finance Operations owns expense reimbursement and vendor payments.
Customer Success owns customer communication and service escalations.

title: Working Hours and Attendance
summary: Attendance recording, core collaboration hours, and regularization rules.

sections.heading: Working schedule
facts: 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM IST, Monday to Friday
Up to 45 minutes between 12:30 PM and 2:30 PM

sections.heading: Attendance recording
paragraphs: Employees record attendance in Nimbus HR. A missing punch must be regularized within two working days and approved by the reporting manager.
Employees who expect to be unavailable during core hours must notify their manager and team channel as early as reasonably possible.

sections.heading: Repeated late arrival
bullets: Three unapproved late arrivals in a calendar month trigger a manager discussion.
A system outage must be reported to the IT Service Desk and should not be treated as an attendance violation when verified.

title: Leave and Holiday Policy
summary: Annual, sick, and casual leave entitlements and approval requirements.

sections.heading: Request and approval
paragraphs: Planned annual leave should be requested at least three working days in advance through Nimbus HR. Emergency leave may be notified on the same day, followed by system submission when practical.
Sick leave longer than two consecutive working days requires a medical certificate. Leave is not approved until the employee receives confirmation in Nimbus HR.

sections.heading: Year-end treatment
bullets: Only annual leave is eligible for carry forward.
Sick leave and casual leave expire at the end of the calendar year.
Carried-forward leave above six days is forfeited in this fictional policy.

title: Hybrid and Remote Work Policy
summary: Eligibility, approval, security, and availability expectations for remote work.

sections.heading: Eligibility and schedule
paragraphs: Eligible employees may work remotely for up to three days per week with manager approval. The arrangement may be changed when customer, operational, training, or security needs require office presence.
Employees must remain reachable during the 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM IST core collaboration window and keep their Nimbus HR work location current.

sections.heading: Security requirements
bullets: Use only a company-managed device for company systems.
Connect through the approved secure-access client when outside a Northstar office.
Do not discuss confidential matters in public locations where conversations may be overheard.
Lock the screen whenever the device is unattended.

sections.heading: Equipment
paragraphs: Standard equipment and reimbursement limits are defined in the attached Remote Work Equipment Standard. Equipment purchases require approval before purchase; retrospective approval is not guaranteed.

title: IT Support and Incident Management
summary: How to request support and how production incidents are prioritized.

sections.heading: Getting support
paragraphs: Submit routine requests through the Nova Service Portal. If the portal is unavailable, email helpdesk@northstar-demo.example or call extension 7700.

sections.heading: Incident priority
facts: Widespread outage or severe security event; acknowledge within 15 minutes; update every 30 minutes
Major degradation with no practical workaround; acknowledge within 30 minutes
Limited impact or workaround available; acknowledge within 4 business hours
Information or standard request; acknowledge within 1 business day

sections.heading: P1 declaration
bullets: Call emergency extension 7788 for a suspected P1.
The Major Incident Manager opens the incident bridge and names a technical lead.
Customer-facing updates are coordinated with Customer Success.
The detailed response sequence is in the IT Incident Response Handbook PDF.

title: Information Security Guidelines
summary: Minimum controls for passwords, phishing, data classification, and approved AI use.

sections.heading: Account protection
facts: Required for email, VPN, administrative, and customer-data systems
Automatic lock after 5 minutes of inactivity

sections.heading: Phishing and suspicious messages
paragraphs: Do not click an unexpected link or approve an unexpected sign-in prompt. Report suspected phishing within 15 minutes using the mail client's Report Phishing button or by forwarding the message as an attachment to security@northstar-demo.example.

sections.heading: Data classification and AI
bullets: Classification levels are Public, Internal, Confidential, and Restricted.
Restricted information must never be entered into an AI tool that has not been approved by Information Security.
Confidential information may be processed only in an approved service with the required contract, retention, and access controls.
The Security Awareness Training video reinforces these rules.

title: Employee Expense Reimbursement
summary: Submission deadlines, receipt requirements, and approval thresholds.

sections.heading: Submission rules
paragraphs: Employees must submit an expense claim in Nimbus Expense within 15 calendar days after the expense date. Itemized receipts are required for individual expenses of INR 500 or more.

sections.heading: Domestic travel limits
facts: Up to INR 6,500 per night excluding taxes
Up to INR 1,200 per travel day
Economy class unless a documented exception is approved

sections.heading: Approvals
bullets: The reporting manager approves the business purpose.
Finance Operations verifies policy compliance and documentation.
Any single claim above INR 25,000 requires approval by the functional director.
Additional examples are in the Travel and Expense Quick Guide PDF.

title: Procurement and Vendor Onboarding
summary: Quotation, security-review, approval, and purchase-order requirements.

sections.heading: Before selecting a vendor
bullets: Confirm the business requirement and budget owner.
Complete vendor due diligence before sharing company or customer information.
Obtain Information Security review when the vendor will access systems, personal information, or Confidential/Restricted data.

sections.heading: Quotation and approval rules
facts: At least three comparable quotations and functional-director approval
Approved purchase order must be issued

sections.heading: Exceptions
paragraphs: A genuine sole-source purchase requires a written justification and approval by Procurement. Urgency alone does not automatically waive security or financial review.

title: Customer Support Escalation
summary: Customer severity definitions, communications, and escalation triggers.

sections.heading: Severity and response
facts: Customer production unavailable; acknowledge within 15 minutes
Major feature unavailable; acknowledge within 30 minutes
Limited issue or standard defect; acknowledge within 4 business hours
How-to or enhancement request; acknowledge within 1 business day

sections.heading: S1 escalation
paragraphs: If an S1 is not assigned to a technical owner within 30 minutes, escalate it to the Customer Success duty manager. Customer updates are issued every 30 minutes unless a different cadence is agreed on the incident bridge.

sections.heading: Communication rules
bullets: State confirmed facts, customer impact, current action, and the next update time.
Do not speculate about root cause or promise compensation.
A root-cause analysis is shared within five business days after a qualifying S1 closure.

title: Business Continuity and Emergency Contacts
summary: Continuity targets, activation triggers, communication, and recovery priorities.

sections.heading: Activation
paragraphs: The continuity plan may be activated by the Incident Commander when an event is expected to exceed a critical service's recovery target, an office becomes unavailable, or employee safety is at risk.

sections.heading: Emergency communication
bullets: Life-safety emergencies must be reported to local emergency services first.
Employees then notify the Northstar emergency extension 7788 when safe to do so.
Only the Communications Lead or delegated spokesperson issues external statements.
Status updates are posted in the designated incident channel and continuity page.
